brief:
Palestinian leaders Khalil al-Hayya and Mohammed Dahlan held talks in Cairo focused on advancing the second phase of the Gaza ceasefire agreement, according to Shehab Wire. The two officials examined political and field developments affecting the implementation process, seeking to establish a coordinated approach to the agreement's next steps.

The meeting also addressed broader efforts to reorganize Palestinian institutional structures. No statement was issued detailing the specific outcomes of the discussions or a timeline for moving forward with the ceasefire's second phase implementation.
